reconstruction_summary: Imported agent's predict.predict(sim_df, platform) which loads coeffs.json (per-platform L, Kus, delta_offset, gain) and applies psi_dot = gain * v * (delta - delta_offset) / (L + Kus * v^2) — agent's V1 'linear-bicycle / understeer-gradient' final shipped model.
notes: V1 linear-bicycle (3 scalars/platform) — fit by Nelder-Mead on agent's train pool; generalises to held-out val.
